claim: Sector types 616/617 drag every wall of the sector; the Marked types 614/615 drag only walls flagged cstat 16384 (with the motion) or 32768 (against it). Sprites in the sector ride by their own cstat 8192 (with) or 16384 (against), whatever the walls do; an unflagged sprite standing on the floor rides too when the XSECTOR's drag bit is set; markers never move (in modern maps, unless flagged 1). A gate can therefore be sprites alone: 30 marked sectors in the campaign move only sprites.
